authority_boundary: Micron is primary for its own qualification announcement. A bounded reverse search did not recover an NVIDIA page naming the Micron 9550, so independent NVIDIA confirmation remains unresolved.
claim_relevant_visible_text: 9550 PCIe Gen5 E1.S data center SSDs have been added to the NVIDIA recommended vendor list for the NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 system
precision_guard: This is a supplier-reported qualification/approved-vendor milestone, not proof of customer shipment volume, deployment fleet size, SSD units, exabytes, or QLC adoption. The 9550 is an AI-storage platform signal but is not used as QLC evidence.
researcher_paraphrase: Micron reported that its 9550 E1.S data-center SSD was on the recommended-vendor list for NVIDIA's GB200 NVL72 system.
source_title: Micron SSDs Qualified for Recommended Vendor List on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72
